WeChatAdapter — Official Account style channel adapter.

Receiving: startWebhook(port) launches an embedded HTTP server on a dedicated OS thread. It handles WeChat's GET verification challenge and POST message delivery, validates the SHA1 signature, and pushes parsed events into a thread-safe Channel drained by tryRecvEvent().

For testing or external forwarding, enqueueWebhookXml() accepts raw XML directly without going through the HTTP path.

Sending: Uses WeChat Official Account APIs for customer-service text messages and template messages.
